name: managed-docker-tracker-commands
goal: The normal task process preserves provider streams and an offline guest Tracker shim reaches the host-signed service for exactly its assigned item and run. Verify duplicate retries, denied scope, and task-owned cleanup in isolated Docker.

evidence: The managed Linux task routes provider prompt and output through a raw Docker attach. The signed relay is a separate sync fixture with no task shim. A synthetic provider must invoke tracker against its assigned run while preserving its existing stdin and stdout contract.

Extend the provider execution method states with an attached Linux task whose provider runs the real tracker executable. Exercise the same taskProcess entrypoint against local subprocess streams first and against the original Docker adapter on MB2.
Exact synthetic transport red returned 71 with no signed traffic.
Provider I/O stays separate from bounded Tracker relay frames. Native host service verifies the assigned run and writes replay receipts atomically.
The unchanged synthetic transport assertion passed in a sealed Harness snapshot. Separate native foreground regression verifies run completion and journal replay.
